title: desmodium hartwegianum var. amans
intro: Desmodium hartwegianum var. amans, commonly known as Amans' tick clover, is a variety of the Desmodium hartwegianum plant species, a type of legume native to Central America and Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Amans' tick clover are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Desmodium hartwegianum var. amans include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
